entities.title: Daemon sharing, handshake and lifetime
entities.summary: An in-process daemon on a temporary socket is checked for sharing, stable session propagation, the version and root checks, idle exit and refusing a second instance.
criteria: Two clients share one engine, both get answers from the same index, and their records retain the stable hello session

An older client is refused with restart: false, the daemon's version and the restart command, and the daemon stays; a newer one makes it drain: busy clients finish, new ones are refused, then it exits
A root that is not a git work tree is rejected in the handshake
The daemon exits after the idle period with no clients
A second daemon on the same socket refuses to start
The handshake reply is decoded as UTF-8, so an error naming a non-ASCII path arrives as sent
entities.details: Spawning a detached daemon (Proxy.SpawnDaemon) is covered by the daemon-commands checks, which run the built executable; the stdio pump (Proxy.Pump) is not covered by these tests, and the CI smoke step in .github/workflows/ci.yml runs the published binary's serve command, which goes through it.

entities.title: status, stop and restart
entities.summary: The commands are checked in process against DaemonServer, against real daemon processes started from the built executable on a temporary state folder, and against a stand-in for a daemon from before the commands.
criteria: the status command reports pid, version, socket, state folder, the connected session with its roots, and each root's file count, readiness and age, without opening a session
the stop command marks the daemon draining and lists the client it waits for; new clients are told to restart and the daemon exits when the client leaves; an unknown command is refused
with no daemon, status prints not running in text and JSON (tool, version, ok false, running false) and exits 3, and stop has nothing to do

restart starts a daemon when none runs; status then shows its client and root and exits 0; restart kills a daemon whose client stays past the timeout and starts a new one with another pid; stop stops a daemon without clients gracefully
a daemon from before the commands is reported running with the version from its refusal, exit 0, and stop makes it drain and exit
help and --help list every command, --version prints csharp-indexer and the version, and unknown commands or arguments exit 2
entities.details: The real-process tests run src/bin/<configuration>/<framework>/<runtime>/csharp-indexer, which dotnet test builds as the test project's reference. Finding an older daemon's process with lsof was tried by hand against a build of the previous commit on Linux, not by a test.
